title: Shipment failures escape error handling
description: FulfillmentService.fulfill books shipments with items.forEach(async ...). forEach ignores the returned promises, so the surrounding try/catch never sees carrier errors: the order is marked shipped immediately and each failure surfaces later as an unhandled promise rejection.
reproduction: Create a paid order with two items.
Make the shipping gateway fail for one of the SKUs.
fulfill() resolves, the order is marked shipped, and an unhandled rejection is raised.

failing_test.name: reports carrier failures and does not mark the order as shipped

expected_behavior: fulfill() rejects with FulfillmentError, no unhandled rejection escapes, and the order stays 'paid'.
regression_tests: ships every item of a paid order
refuses to fulfill an unpaid order
